platform: Apple M4 Max, macOS 26.6.2, arm64 release
method: 20 Down, then 20 Up. Native AX observation after each action. No file activations during traversal. Filesystem caches not flushed; other desktop and development activity remained running.
boundary: Application selection handler through generation/mode-checked GPUI frame callback after changed-file list. Excludes pre-handler input delivery, OS presentation and completed GPU execution.
limits: Small local measurement, not cold-disk, comparative benchmark, or latency/memory guarantee. Earlier layout trace includes eager previews and is not directly comparable.

file_comparisons.method: 20 Down then 20 Up in the focused file list, observing native AX after each action. Starts and ends on the same file. The preceding first open and retained-content return are excluded. These are text/code comparisons, not image-decode benchmarks.
file_comparisons.cache: Application remained open after history traversal. First traversal covers different file previews; return traversal can hit the 32-entry preview cache. Filesystem caches were not flushed. Editors are reconstructed lazily when changing files.
